property_summary: For every caller, c.transferOwnership succeeds if and only if that caller is the current owner; the mutant inverts the onlyOwner guard so non-owners succeed and the owner reverts, breaking this rule.
change_summary: Insert an inverted ownership check so that only non-owners pass the guard, letting a non-owner change the owner while the real owner is blocked.
